---
title: "Data"
description: "Tabular data, APIs and database-oriented workflows."
---

<div class="toolbox-kind">Index</div>

- [Dataframes](../snippets/dataframe.qmd): import, inspect, transform, join and export tabular data.
- [API requests](../snippets/api.qmd): HTTP, JSON, pagination and raw-response preservation.
- [Statistics](../snippets/statistics.qmd): descriptive summaries and distributions.
- [Text analysis](../snippets/text.qmd): corpus operations and NLP pointers.

SQL is intentionally a low priority. For database work, prefer connecting from R or Python, inspecting tables, selecting/filtering remotely and collecting only the relevant data. In R, `DBI`, `dbplyr` and `dplyr` are the default direction.
